call_lightning.desc: Nube temporalesca. 3d10 danni da fulmine ogni turno per 10 min.

clairvoyance.name: Clairvoyance
clairvoyance.desc: You create an Invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you (a place you have visited or seen before) or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar to you (such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees).

conjure_animals.name: Conjure Animals
conjure_animals.desc: You conjure nature spirits that appear as a Large pack of spectral, intangible animals in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The pack lasts for the duration, and you choose the spirits’ animal form, such as wolves, serpents, or birds.

create_food_and_water.name: Create Food and Water
create_food_and_water.desc: You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of fresh water on the ground or in containers within range—both useful in fending off the hazards of malnutrition and dehydration. The food is bland but nourishing and looks like a food of your choice, and the water is clean.

fear.name: Fear
fear.desc: Each creature in a 30-foot Cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and have the Frightened condition for the duration.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.desc: A bright streak flashes from you to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into a fiery explosion.

fly.name: Fly
fly.desc: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover. WUhseinn tgh ae Hspigelhl eern-dLse,v tehle S tpaerlgl eStl ofatl.ls if it is still aloft unless it can stop the fall.

gaseous_form.name: Gaseous Form
gaseous_form.desc: A willing creature you touch shape-shifts, along with everything it’s wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud for the duration. The spell ends on the target if it drops to 0 Hit Points or if it takes a Magic action to end the spell on itself.

glyph_of_warding.name: Glyph of Warding
glyph_of_warding.desc: You inscribe a glyph that later unleashes a magical effect. You inscribe it either on a surface (such as a table or a section of floor) or within an object that can be closed (such as a book or chest) to conceal the glyph.

haste.name: Haste
haste.desc: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target’s Speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to Armor Class, it has Advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns.

hypnotic_pattern.name: Hypnotic Pattern
hypnotic_pattern.desc: You create a twisting pattern of colors in a 30-foot Cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who can see the pattern must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration.

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.desc: A stroke of lightning forming a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the Line makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Lightning damage o nU as ifnagil ead H siagvhee orrLheavlef la Ss pmeullc Shl odta.

magic_circle.name: Magic Circle
magic_circle.desc: You create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall Cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range. Glowing runes appear wherever the Cylinder intersects with the floor or other surface.

major_image.name: Major Image
major_image.desc: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot Cube. The image appears at a spot that you can see within range and lasts for the duration.

mass_healing_word.name: Mass Healing Word
mass_healing_word.desc: Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see wUitshiinng r aan Hgieg rheegra-iLne Hveitl SPpoeinllt sS leoqtu.al to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. The healing inMass Suggestion creases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 3.

meld_into_stone.name: Meld into Stone
meld_into_stone.desc: You step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, merging yourself and your equipment with the stone for the duration. You must touch the stone to do so. Nothing of your presence remains visible or otherwise detectable by nonmagical senses.

nondetection.name: Nondetection
nondetection.desc: For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from Divination spells. The target can be a willing creature, or it can be a place or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension.

phantom_steed.name: Phantom Steed
phantom_steed.desc: A Large, quasi-real, horselike creature appears on the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice within range. You decide the creature’s appearance, and it is equipped with a saddle, bit, and bridle.

remove_curse.name: Remove Curse
remove_curse.desc: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell breaks its owner’s Attunement to the object so it can be removed or Resilient Sphere discarded.

revivify.name: Revivify
revivify.desc: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature revives with 1 Hit Point. This spell can’t revive a creature that has died of old age, Rope Trick nor does it restore any missing body parts.

sending.name: Sending
sending.desc: You send a short message of 25 words or fewer to a creature you have met or a creature described to you by someone who has met it. The target hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately.

sleet_storm.name: Tempesta di neve
sleet_storm.desc: 2d8 danni da freddo + bersaglio cieco in area cilindrica.

slow.name: Slow
slow.desc: You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot Cube within range. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by this spell for the duration.

speak_with_dead.name: Speak with Dead
speak_with_dead.desc: You grant the semblance of life to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer questions you pose. The corpse must have a mouth, and this spell fails if the deceased creature was Undead when it died.

speak_with_plants.name: Speak with Plants
speak_with_plants.desc: You imbue plants in an immobile 30-foot Emanation with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow your simple commands.

spirit_guardians.name: Guardiani spirituali
spirit_guardians.desc: Spiriti tutelari in 4,5m raggio. 3d8 danni a nemici che entrano.

stinking_cloud.name: Stinking Cloud
stinking_cloud.desc: You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range. The cloud is Heavily ObGscuusrt eodf .W Tihned cloud lingers in the air for the duration or until a strong wind (such as the one created by ) disperses it.

tiny_hut.name: Tiny Hut
tiny_hut.desc: A 10-foot Emanation springs into existence around you and remains stationary for the duration. The spell fails when you cast it if the Emanation isn’t big enough to fully encapsulate all creatures in its area.

vampiric_touch.name: Vampiric Touch
vampiric_touch.desc: The touch of your shadow-wreathed hand can siphon life force from others to heal your wounds. Make a melee spell attack against one creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 Necrotic damage, and you regain Hit Points equal to half the amount of Necrotic damage dealt.

water_walk.name: Water Walk
water_walk.desc: This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface—such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava—as if it were harmless solid ground (creatures crossing molten lava can still take damage from the heat).

wind_wall.name: Wind Wall
wind_wall.desc: A wall of strong wind rises from the ground at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick. You can shape the wall in any way you choose so long as it makes one continuous path along the ground.

arcane_eye.name: Arcano occhio
arcane_eye.desc: Occhio invisibile che si muove 9m/turno. Visione nel buio.

aura_of_life.name: Aura of Life
aura_of_life.desc: An aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and your allies have Resistance to Necrotic damage, and your Hit Point maximums can’t be reduced.

black_tentacles.name: Black Tentacles
black_tentacles.desc: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within range. For the duration, these tentacles turn the ground in that area into Difficult Terrain. Each creature in that area makes a Strength saving throw.

compulsion.name: Compulsion
compulsion.desc: Each creature of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition until the spell ends. For the duration, you can take a Bonus Action to designate a direction that is horizontal to you.

confusion.name: Confusione
confusion.desc: Fino a 6 creature agiscono in modo caotico per 1 min.

conjure_minor_elementals.name: Conjure Minor Elementals
conjure_minor_elementals.desc: You conjure spirits from the Elemental Planes that flit around you in a 15-foot Emanation for the duration. Until the spell ends, any attack you make deals an extra 2d8 damage when you hit a creature in the Emanation.

conjure_woodland_beings.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
conjure_woodland_beings.desc: You conjure nature spirits that flit around you in a 10-foot Emanation for the duration.

control_water.name: Control Water
control_water.desc: Until the spell ends, you control any water inside an area you choose that is a Cube up to 100 feet on a side, using one of the following effects. As a Magic a cFtiloono do.n your later turns, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one.

death_ward.name: Death Ward
death_ward.desc: You touch a creature and grant it a measure of protection from death. The first time the target would drop to 0 Hit Points before the spell ends, the target instead drops to 1 Hit Point, and the spell ends.

divination.name: Divination
divination.desc: This spell puts you in contact with a god or a god’s servants. You ask one question about a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. The GM offers a truthful reply, which might be a short phrase or cryptic rhyme.

dominate_beast.name: Dominate Beast
dominate_beast.desc: One Beast you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration. The target has Advantage on the save if you or your allies are fighting it.

fabricate.name: Fabbricare
fabricate.desc: Crei un oggetto da materie prime.

faithful_hound.name: Faithful Hound
faithful_hound.desc: You conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The hound remains for the duration or until the two of you are more than 300 feet apart from each other. No one but you can see the hound, and it is intangible and invulnerable.

fire_shield.name: Fire Shield
fire_shield.desc: Wispy flames wreathe your body for the duration, shedding Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. The flames provide you with a warm shield or a chill shield, as you choose.

freedom_of_movement.name: Freedom of Movement
freedom_of_movement.desc: You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target’s movement is unaffected by Difficult Terrain, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target’s Speed nor cause the target to have the Paralyzed or Restrained conditions.

giant_insect.name: Giant Insect
giant_insect.desc: You summon a giant centipede, spider, or wasp (chosen Gwihaennt yInouse ccatst the spell). It manifests in an unoccupied space you can see within range and uses the stat block. The form you choose determines certain details in its stat block.

greater_invisibility.name: Greater Invisibility
greater_invisibility.desc: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition unGreater Restoration til the spell ends.

guardian_of_faith.name: Guardian of Faith
guardian_of_faith.desc: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The guardian occupies that space and is invulnerable, and it appears in a form appropriate for your deity or pantheon.

hallucinatory_terrain.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
hallucinatory_terrain.desc: You make natural terrain in a 150-foot Cube in range look, sound, and smell like another sort of natural terrain. Thus, open fields or a road can be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain.

ice_storm.name: Ice Storm
ice_storm.desc: Hail falls in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in the Cylinder makes a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 2d10 Bludgeoning damage and 4d6 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

phantasmal_killer.name: Phantasmal Killer
phantasmal_killer.desc: You tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see within range and create an illusion of its deepest fears, visible only to that creature. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.

polymorph.name: Polymorph
polymorph.desc: You attempt to transform a creature that you can see within range into a Beast. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or shape-shift into a Beast form for the duration.

private_sanctum.name: Private Sanctum
private_sanctum.desc: You make an area within range magically secure. The area is a Cube that can be as small as 5 feet to as large as 100 feet on each side. The spell lasts for the duration.

resilient_sphere.name: Resilient Sphere
resilient_sphere.desc: A shimmering sphere encloses a Large or smaller creature or object within range. An unwilling creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be enclosed for the duration.

secret_chest.name: Secret Chest
secret_chest.desc: You hide a chest and all its contents on the Ethereal Plane. You must touch the chest and the miniature replica that serve as Material components for the spell. The chest can contain up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving material (3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet).

stone_shape.name: Stone Shape
stone_shape.desc: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape you like.

vitriolic_sphere.name: Vitriolic Sphere
vitriolic_sphere.desc: You point at a location within range, and a glowing, 1-foot-diameter ball of acid streaks there and explodes in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in that area makes a Dexterity saving throw.

wall_of_fire.name: Wall of Fire
wall_of_fire.desc: You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for the duration.

animate_objects.name: Animate Objects
animate_objects.desc: Objects animate at your command. Choose a number of nonmagical objects within range that aren’t being worn or carried, aren’t fixed to a surface, and aren’t Gargantuan.

antilife_shell.name: Antilife Shell
antilife_shell.desc: An aura extends from you in a 10-foot Emanation for the duration. The aura prevents creatures other than Constructs and Undead from passing or reaching through it. An affected creature can cast spells or make attacks with Ranged or Reach weapons through the barrier.

arcane_hand.name: Cono di freddo
arcane_hand.desc: Cono 18m. 8d8 danni da freddo. TS COS dimezza.

awaken.name: Awaken
awaken.desc: You spend the casting time tracing magical pathways within a precious gemstone, and then touch the target. The target must be either a Beast or Plant creature with an Intelligence of 3 or less or a natural plant that isn’t a creature.

cloudkill.name: Cloudkill
cloudkill.desc: You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow-green fog centered onG au psto oinf tW winitdhin range. The fog lasts for the duration or until strong wind (such as the one created by ) disperses it, ending the spell. Its area is Heavily Obscured.

commune.name: Commune
commune.desc: You contact a deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question.

commune_with_nature.name: Commune with Nature
commune_with_nature.desc: You commune with nature spirits and gain knowledge of the surrounding area. In the outdoors, the spell gives you knowledge of the area within 3 miles of you. In caves and other natural underground settings, the radius is limited to 300 feet.

cone_of_cold.name: Cone of Cold
cone_of_cold.desc: You unleash a blast of cold air. Each creature in a 60-foot Cone originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a succeUsssfiunlg o an eH. iAg hcerer-aLteuvree lk Siplleeldl bSlyo tth.

conjure_elemental.name: Conjure Elemental
conjure_elemental.desc: You conjure a Large, intangible spirit from the Elemental Planes that appears in an unoccupied space within range. Choose the spirit’s element, which determines its damage type: air (Lightning), earth (Thunder), fire (Fire), or water (Cold). The spirit lasts for the duration.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.desc: Your touch inflicts a magical contagion. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 11d8 Necrotic damage and have the Poisoned condition. Also, choose one ability when you cast the spell.

creation.name: Creation
creation.desc: You pull wisps of shadow material from the Shadowfell to create an object within range. It is either an object of vegetable matter (soft goods, rope, wood, and the like) or mineral matter (stone, crystal, metal, and the like).

dispel_evil_and_good.name: Dispel Evil and Good
dispel_evil_and_good.desc: For the duration, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls agBarinesatk y Eonuc. hYaoun tcmane netn.d the spell early by using either of the following special functions.

dominate_person.name: Dominare persona
dominate_person.desc: Controllo completo su un umanoide. TS SAG ogni turno.

dream.name: Dream
dream.desc: You target a creature you know on the same plane of existence. You or a willing creature you touch enters a trance state to act as a dream messenger. While in the trance, the messenger is Incapacitated and has a Speed of 0.

flame_strike.name: Flame Strike
flame_strike.desc: A vertical column of brilliant fire roars down from above. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foothigh Cylinder centered on a point within range makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d6 Fire d aUmsiangge aan Hdi g5hde6r R-Laedviealn St pdealml Salgoet .

insect_plague.name: Insect Plague
insect_plague.desc: Swarming locusts fill a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The Sphere remains for the duration, and its area is Lightly Obscured and Difficult Terrain.

legend_lore.name: Legend Lore
legend_lore.desc: Name or describe a famous person, place, or object. The spell brings to your mind a brief summary of the significant lore about that famous thing, as described by the GM.

mass_cure_wounds.name: Grande restaurazione
mass_cure_wounds.desc: Rimuovi affaticamento, incantesimi, maledizioni, paralisi, pietrificazione.

mislead.name: Mislead
mislead.desc: You gain the Invisible condition at the same time that an illusory double of you appears where you are standing. The double lasts for the duration, but the invisibility ends immediately after you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell.

modify_memory.name: Modify Memory
modify_memory.desc: You attempt to reshape another creature’s memories. One creature that you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. If you are fighting the creature, it has Advantage on the save. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed condition for the duration.

passwall.name: Scagliare incantesimo
passwall.desc: Trasferisci un incantesimo in un'arma o oggetto.

raise_dead.name: Raise Dead
raise_dead.desc: With a touch, you revive a dead creature if it has been dead no longer than 10 days and it wasn’t Undead when it died. The creature returns to life with 1 Hit Point. This spell also neutralizes any poisons that affected the creature at the time of death.

reincarnate.name: Reincarnate
reincarnate.desc: You touch a dead Humanoid or a piece of one. If the creature has been dead no longer than 10 days, the spell forms a new body for it and calls the soul to enter that body.

seeming.name: Seeming
seeming.desc: You give an illusory appearance to each creature of your choice that you can see within range. An unwilling target can make a Charisma saving throw, and if it succeeds, it is unaffected by this spell. You can give the same appearance or different ones to the targets.

summon_dragon.name: Summon Dragon
summon_dragon.desc: You call fDorrtahc oa nDirca Sgpoinr istpirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends. The creature is an ally to you and your allies.

telekinesis.name: Telecinesi
telekinesis.desc: Muovi oggetti o creature a distanza con la mente.

telepathic_bond.name: Telepathic Bond
telepathic_bond.desc: You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range, psychically linking each creature to all the others for the duration. Creatures that can’t communicate in any languages aren’t affected by this spell.

teleportation_circle.name: Teleportation Circle
teleportation_circle.desc: As you cast the spell, you draw a 5-foot-radius circle on the ground inscribed with sigils that link your location to a permanent teleportation circle of your choice whose sigil sequence you know and that is on the same plane of existence as you.

tree_stride.name: Tree Stride
tree_stride.desc: You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. Both trees must be living and at least the same size as you. You must use 5 feet of movement to enter a tree.

wall_of_force.name: Telepatia
wall_of_force.desc: Comunicazione mentale con una creatura ovunque si trovi.

wall_of_stone.name: Wall of Stone
wall_of_stone.desc: A nonmagical wall of solid stone springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall is 6 inches thick and is composed of ten 10-foot-by10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel.

blade_barrier.name: Barriera di lame
blade_barrier.desc: Muro di lame rotanti. 6d10 danni taglienti per attraversamento.

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.desc: You launch a lightning bolt toward a target you can see within range. Three bolts then leap from that target to as many as three other targets of your choice, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first target.

circle_of_death.name: Circle of Death
circle_of_death.desc: Negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius Sphere from a point you choose within range. Each creature in that area makes a Constitution saving thUroswin,g t aak Hinigg h8edr8LNeevcerlo Stpice dlla Smloatg.e on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

conjure_fey.name: Conjure Fey
conjure_fey.desc: You conjure a Medium spirit from the Feywild in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The spirit lasts for the duration, and it looks like a Fey creature of your choice. When the spirit appears, you can make one melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

contingency.name: Contingency
contingency.desc: Choose a spell of level 5 or lower that you can cast, that has a casting time of an acCtoinotni,n agnedn ctyhat can target you. You cast that spell—called the contingent spell—as part of casting , expending spell slots for both, but the contingent spell doesn’t come into effect.

create_undead.name: Create Undead
create_undead.desc: You can cast this spell only at nightG. hCohuolose up to three corpses of Medium or Small Humanoids within range. Each one becomes a under your control (see “Monsters” for its stat block).

disintegrate.name: Disintegrate
disintegrate.desc: You launch a green ray at a target you can see within range. The targWeta clal nof b Feo arc cer.eature, a nonmagical object, or a creation of magical force, such as the wall created by A creature targeted by this spell makes a Dexterity saving throw.

eyebite.name: Eyebite
eyebite.desc: For the duration, your eyes become an inky void. One creature of your choice within 60 feet of you that you can see must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects of your choice for the duration.

find_the_path.name: Find the Path
find_the_path.desc: You magically sense the most direct physical route to a location you name.

flesh_to_stone.name: Flesh to Stone
flesh_to_stone.desc: You attempt to turn one creature that you can see within range into stone. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the Restrained condition for the duration. On a successful save, its Speed is 0 until the start of your next turn.

forbiddance.name: Forbiddance
forbiddance.desc: You create a ward against magical travel that protects up to 40,000 square feet of floor space to a height of 30 feet above the floGoart. eFor the duration, creatures can’t teleport into the area or use portals, such as those created by the spell, to enter the area.

freezing_sphere.name: Freezing Sphere
freezing_sphere.desc: A frigid globe streaks from you to a point of your choice within range, where it explodes in a 60-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in that area makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d6 Cold damage on failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

globe_of_invulnerability.name: Globe of Invulnerability
globe_of_invulnerability.desc: Sfera 3m. Incantesimi 5° o inferiori non possono entrare.

guards_and_wards.name: Guards and Wards
guards_and_wards.desc: You create a ward that protects up to 2,500 square feet of floor space. The warded area can be up to 20 feet tall, and you shape it as one 50-foot square, one hundred 5-foot squares that are contiguous, or twenty-five 10-foot squares that are contiguous.

harm.name: Harm
harm.desc: 14d6 danni necrotici. TS COS dimezza. Riduce HP massimi.

heal.name: Heal
heal.desc: Choose a creature that you can see within range. Positive energy washes through the target, restorinUg s7i0n gH iat HPoiginhtesr. -TLheivse sl pSeplel lall Ssolo etn.ds the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions on the target.

heroes_feast.name: Heroes’ Feast
heroes_feast.desc: You conjure a feast that appears on a surface in an unoccupied 10-foot Cube next to you. The feast takes 1 hour to consume and disappears at the end of that time, and the beneficial effects don’t set in until this hour is over. Up to twelve creatures can partake of the feast.

instant_summons.name: Instant Summons
instant_summons.desc: You touch the sapphire used in the casting and an object weighing 10 pounds or less whose longest dimension is 6 feet or less. The spell leaves an Invisible mark on that object and invisibly inscribes the object’s name on the sapphire.

irresistible_dance.name: Irresistible Dance
irresistible_dance.desc: One creature that you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the target dances comically until the end of its next turn, during which it must spend all its movement to dance in place.

magic_jar.name: Magic Jar
magic_jar.desc: Your body falls into a catatonic state as your soul leaves it and enters the container you used for the spell’s Material component. While your soul inhabits the container, you are aware of your surroundings as if you were in the container’s space.

mass_suggestion.name: Mass Suggestion
mass_suggestion.desc: You suggest a course of activity—described in no more than 25 words—to twelve or fewer creatures you can see within range that can hear and understand you.

move_earth.name: Move Earth
move_earth.desc: Choose an area of terrain no larger than 40 feet on a side within range. You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area in any manner you choose for the duration. You can raise or lower the area’s elevation, create or fill in a trench, erect or flatten a wall, or form a pillar.

planar_ally.name: Planar Ally
planar_ally.desc: You beseech an otherworldly entity for aid. The being must be known to you: a god, a demon prince, or some other being of cosmic power. That entity sends a Celestial, an Elemental, or a Fiend loyal to it to aid you, making the creature appear in an unoccupied space within range.

programmed_illusion.name: Programmed Illusion
programmed_illusion.desc: You create an illusion of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon within range that activates when a specific trigger occurs. The illusion is imperceptible until then.

sunbeam.name: Sunbeam
sunbeam.desc: You launch a sunbeam in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long Line. Each creature in the Line makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 6d8 Radiant damage and has the Blinded condition until the start of your next turn.

transport_via_plants.name: Transport via Plants
transport_via_plants.desc: This spell creates a magical link between a Large or larger inanimate plant within range and another plant, at any distance, on the same plane of existence. You must have seen or touched the destination plant at least once before.

wall_of_ice.name: Wall of Ice
wall_of_ice.desc: You create a wall of ice on a solid surface within range. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a globe with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-square panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel.

wall_of_thorns.name: Wall of Thorns
wall_of_thorns.desc: You create a wall of tangled brush bristling with needle-sharp thorns. The wall appears within range on a solid surface and lasts for the duration.

wind_walk.name: Wind Walk
wind_walk.desc: You and up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range assume gaseous forms for the duration, appearing as wisps of cloud.

word_of_recall.name: Word of Recall
word_of_recall.desc: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary. You and any creatures that teleport with you appear in the nearest unoccupied space to the spot you designated when you prepared your sanctuary (see below).

arcane_sword.name: Arcane Sword
arcane_sword.desc: You create a spectral sword that hovers within range. It lasts for the duration. When the sword appears, you make a melee spell attack against a target within 5 feet of the sword. On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to 4d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

conjure_celestial.name: Conjure Celestial
conjure_celestial.desc: You conjure a spirit from the Upper Planes, which manifests as a pillar of light in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. For each creature you can see in the Cylinder, Healing Light. choose which of these lights shines on it: Searing Light.

delayed_blast_fireball.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
delayed_blast_fireball.desc: A beam of yellow light flashes from you, then condenses at a chosen point within range as a glowing bead for the duration. When the spell ends, the bead explodes, and each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw.

divine_word.name: Divine Word
divine_word.desc: You utter a word imbued with power from the Upper Planes. Each creature of your choice in range makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a target that has 50 Hit Points or fewer suffers an effect based on its current Hit Points, as shown in the Divine Word Effects table.

finger_of_death.name: Dito della morte
finger_of_death.desc: 7d8+30 danni necrotici. TS COS dimezza. Se muore: zombie permanente.

fire_storm.name: Fire Storm
fire_storm.desc: Area di fiamme 10 cubi 3m. 7d10 danni fuoco. TS DES dimezza.

forcecage.name: Forcecage
forcecage.desc: An immobile, Invisible, Cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range. The prison can be a cage or a solid box, as you choose.

magnificent_mansion.name: Magnificent Mansion
magnificent_mansion.desc: You conjure a shimmering door in range that lasts for the duration. The door leads to an extradimensional dwelling and is 5 feet wide and 10 feet tall.

mirage_arcane.name: Mirage Arcane
mirage_arcane.desc: You make terrain in an area up to 1 mile square look, sound, smell, and even feel like some other sort of terrain. Open fields or a road could be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other rough or impassable terrain.

prismatic_spray.name: Prismatic Spray
prismatic_spray.desc: Eight rays of light flash from you in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a Dexterity saving throw. For each target, roll 1d8 to determine which color ray affects it, consulting the Prismatic Rays tParbilsem. atic Rays 1d8 Ray 1 Red. Failed Save: 12d6 Fire damage.

project_image.name: Project Image
project_image.desc: You create an illusory copy of yourself that lasts for the duration. The copy can appear at any location within range that you have seen before, regardless of intervening obstacles. The illusion looks and sounds like you, but it is intangible.

regenerate.name: Regenerate
regenerate.desc: Rigenera arti mancanti. 4d8+15 HP + 1 HP/turno per 1h.

resurrection.name: Resurrection
resurrection.desc: Resuscita un morto da meno di 100 anni. Recupera tutti gli HP.

reverse_gravity.name: Reverse Gravity
reverse_gravity.desc: This spell reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100foot high Cylinder centered on a point within range. All creatures and objects in that area that aren’t anchored to the ground fall upward and reach the top of the Cylinder.

sequester.name: Sequester
sequester.desc: With a touch, you magically sequester an object or a willing creature. For the duration, the target has the Invisible condition and can’t be targeted by Divination spells, detected by magic, or viewed remotely with magic.

simulacrum.name: Simulacrum
simulacrum.desc: You create a simulacrum of one Beast or Humanoid that is within 10 feet of you for the entire casting of the spell.

symbol.name: Symbol
symbol.desc: You inscribe a harmful glyph either on a surface (such as a section of floor or wall) or within an object that can be closed (such as a book or chest). The glyph can cover an area no larger than 10 feet in diameter.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.desc: Teletrasporto in qualsiasi luogo dello stesso piano.

animal_shapes.name: Animal Shapes
animal_shapes.desc: Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. Each target shape-shifts into a Large or smaller Beast of your choice that has a Challenge Rating of 4 or lower. You can choose a different form for each target.

antimagic_field.name: Antimagic Field
antimagic_field.desc: Sfera 3m senza magia. Incantesimi e oggetti magici non funzionano.

antipathysympathy.name: Antipathy/Sympathy
antipathysympathy.desc: As you cast the spell, choose whether it creates antipathy or sympathy, and target one creature or object that is Huge or smaller. Then specify a kind of creature, such as red dragons, goblins, or vampires.

befuddlement.name: Befuddlement
befuddlement.desc: You blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range. The target makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 10d12 Psychic damage and can’t cast spells or take the Magic action.

clone.name: Clone
clone.desc: Crei un clone del tuo corpo come rifugio per la tua anima.

control_weather.name: Control Weather
control_weather.desc: You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell, and it ends early if you go indoors. When you cast the spell, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the GM.

demiplane.name: Demiplane
demiplane.desc: You create a shadowy Medium door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range. This door can be opened and closed, and it leads to a demiplane that is an empty room 30 feet in each dimension, made of wood or stone (your choice).

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.desc: Choose a point on the ground that you can see within range. For the duration, an intense tremor rips through the ground in a 100-foot-radius circle centered on that point. The ground there is Difficult Terrain.

glibness.name: Glibness
glibness.desc: Until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15. Additionally, no matter what you say, magic that would determine if you are telling the truth indiGlobe of Invulnerability cates that you are being truthful.

holy_aura.name: Holy Aura
holy_aura.desc: For the duration, you emit an aura in a 30-foot Emanation. While in the aura, creatures of your choice have Advantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against them.

incendiary_cloud.name: Incendiary Cloud
incendiary_cloud.desc: A swirling cloud of embers and smoke fills a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range. The Gcluosutd o’sf Warienad is Heavily Obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a strong wind (like that created by ) disperses it.

maze.name: Maze
maze.desc: You banish a creature that you can see within range into a labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains there for the duration or until it escapes the maze. The target can take a Study action to try to escape. When it does so, it makes a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check.

mind_blank.name: Mind Blank
mind_blank.desc: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch has Immunity to Psychic damage and the Charmed condition.

sunburst.name: Sunburst
sunburst.desc: Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the Sphere makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 12d6 Radiant damage and has the Blinded condition for 1 minute.

tsunami.name: Tsunami
tsunami.desc: A wall of water springs into existence at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick. The wall lasts for the duration.

astral_projection.name: Astral Projection
astral_projection.desc: Proietta te e alleati nel Piano Astrale.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.desc: Non puoi essere sorpreso. Vantaggio a tutto. Svantaggio contro di te. 8h.

gate.name: Gate
gate.desc: You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence. The portal is a circular opening, which you can make 5 to 20 feet in diameter. You can orient the portal in any direction you choose.

mass_heal.name: Mass Heal
mass_heal.desc: A flood of healing energy flows from you into creatures around you. You restore up to 700 Hit Points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range.

meteor_swarm.name: Meteor Swarm
meteor_swarm.desc: 4 meteore su punti entro 1,5km. 20d6 fuoco + 20d6 contundenti ciascuna.

power_word_heal.name: Power Word Heal
power_word_heal.desc: A wave of healing energy washes over one creature you can see within range. The target regains all its Hit Points. If the creature has the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned condition, the condition ends.

prismatic_wall.name: Prismatic Wall
prismatic_wall.desc: A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall—up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick—centered on a point within range. Alternatively, you shape the wall into a globe up to 30 feet in diameter centered on a point within range.

shapechange.name: Shapechange
shapechange.desc: You shape-shift into another creature for the duration or until you take a Magic action to shape-shift into a different eligible form. The new form must be of a creature that has a Challenge Rating no higher than your level or Challenge Rating.

storm_of_vengeance.name: Storm of Vengeance
storm_of_vengeance.desc: A churning storm cloud forms for the duration, centered on a point within range and spreading to a radius of 300 feet.

time_stop.name: Time Stop
time_stop.desc: Fermi il tempo. Ottieni 1d4+1 turni da solo.

true_polymorph.name: True Polymorph
true_polymorph.desc: Trasforma permanentemente una creatura o oggetto.

true_resurrection.name: True Resurrection
true_resurrection.desc: You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years and that died for any reason except old age. The creature is revived with all its Hit Points.

weird.name: Weird
weird.desc: You try to create illusory terrors in others’ minds. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 10d10 Psychic damage and has the Frightened condition for the duration.

wish.name: Wish
wish.desc: Replica qualsiasi incantesimo 8° o inferiore, o esprimi un desiderio.
